question: Which layers do the better owner-reported rasters place their dots on? Anchored on registry/owner_reported_live_scores.json.
evidence_class: UNVERIFIED owner-reported (relative ranking instrument only). Not HOLDOUT-DTI and not ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED.
caveats: n = 15 matched artefacts; the score spread is 0.1894-0.2778.
The rasters are not an experimental design: layer dot-mean co-varies with dot count, with the site the owner reports from, and with placement geometry.
Sign-stable layers survive leave-one-out; that is a stability check, not causation.
No coefficient here may be quoted as a score or used to justify a submission alone.
